notes.title: Mars Underground is a finalist for 3 awards at Freeplay 2019!
notes.content:
Very proud to announce that Mars Underground is a finalist in 3 different award categories at Freeplay:
[list]
[*] Excellence in Design
[*] Excellence in Audio
[*] Excellence in Narrative
[/list]

[url=http://www.freeplay.net.au/awards/]Freeplay 2019 Awards Finalists[/url]
